Author: ambychannel (based on Brio by Minmoose, Asgard and Contributors)
Name: FlashBang
Punchline: Multiplayer GPose: share your Brio scene with friends.
Description:
Multiplayer GPose built on Brio. Put lights, props and cameras in a Sync folder and share them live with friends who join your room code.

FlashBang includes all of Brio's tools, so turn off Brio before enabling FlashBang.

Based on Brio by Etheirys (GPL-3.0).
